_comment: Generated by gen_smolvla_binding.py --granularity bundle from the context binaries actually present on the board, NOT from the profile CSVs. The CSVs report an HTA time for all 49 segments, but no ctx_dsp_seg_NN__Hta.bin exists: HTA runs only the extracted Conv1x1 sub-models. At segment granularity NO tile reaches HTA, which is the honest position and is why the published 1083.6 ms is not realizable at this granularity. Use --granularity bundle to expose the conv1x1 tiles that HTA can actually take.
